meta: A chatbot answers a question. An AI agent takes a goal, breaks it into steps, uses tools to do them, checks and fixes its work, and stops to ask you before anything important.

muc.title: One question, one answer
muc.text: Ask AI what to do on a trip to the mountains, and it gives you a list. But booking tickets, booking rooms and planning the schedule are still up to you.

muc.title: What is an AI agent?
muc.text: An AI agent is AI that doesn't just answer. It's given tools so it can do work for you, over many steps.

muc.title: The agent splits up the work
muc.text: You give it a goal. The agent breaks it into steps on its own: find tickets, compare room prices, plan the schedule, add up the cost.

muc.title: It checks and fixes its own work
muc.text: If the result isn't good enough, it reviews and fixes it until it meets the goal.

muc.title: You still make the call
muc.text: But for important things like paying or sending email, a good agent stops and asks you. Always check before you say yes.

muc.title: Agents around us
muc.text: Agents can already do a lot: sort email, make reports. Even the video you're watching was made together with an AI agent.

muc.title: Work together with an agent
muc.text: Give AI a real goal, ask it to make a step-by-step plan, then work through it together, step by step. That's how you start working with agents.
